findings.text: On a custom Chinese Multidisciplinary Treatment (MDT) clinical benchmark, Baichuan-M2 was preferred on Safety in 34% of expert comparisons versus gpt-oss-120B (30%), with 36% ties.

source.quote: While the performance gap narrowed in Treatment (37%) and Safety (34%), Baichuan-M2 maintained an edge, particularly in clinical practicability and risk identification.

findings.text: Authors say Baichuan-M2 may still exhibit response hallucinations and unstable reasoning in some edge cases.

findings.text: On a [HealthBench](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.08775) Hard gestational-diabetes insulin case, authors claim Baichuan-M2 was stronger on medical accuracy and safety than gpt-oss-120B, without numeric safety scores.

source.quote: Among these, Baichuan-M2 demonstrates superior completeness of medical thinking, medical accuracy, and safety.

findings.text: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) data was optimized for medical scenarios including medical safety, but no separate safety-benchmark scores are reported for that mix.
